notes: Requires a reusable CLI optimizer (/app/solve.py) that generalizes to hidden parameter boxes. Difficulty comes from hidden-case generalization (arbitrary inclusive integer boxes), adversarial/malformed inputs (missing keys, lo>hi, single-point boxes), and quantitative correctness (float score to 1e-6, exact evaluation counting, and deterministic tie-breaking by smallest a then b). The documented numerically-unstable step adds a light ambiguity: the closed-form sim.score is authoritative and must be used.
